#data cleaning process

str(data)

#check and detect missing values

```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```




#separate continous and categorical functions

```{r}
continous_vars<- c("Age",
                   "Income_KES",
                   "Household_Size",
                   "Farm_Size_Acres",
                   "Monthly_Expenses_KES",
                   "Years_Experience"
                   
                   )
  
  
categorical_vars<- c(
  "Education",
  "Gender",
  "Extension_Access",
  "Adoption_Status"
  
)
head(continous_vars)

```



# checking miss values in continous variables

```{r}
colSums(is.na(data[continous_vars]))
```



#replace the missing values with mean
```{r}
for(var in continous_vars){
  data[[var]][is.na(data[[var]])]<-
    mean(data[[var]], na.rm= TRUE)
}
colSums(is.na(data[continous_vars]))
```




```{r}
for(var in continous_vars){
  data[[var]][is.na(data[[var]])]<-
    mean(data[[var]], na.rm=TRUE)
  
}
cat("Data successful replaced with the mean:\n and updated","\n")
colSums(is.na(data[continous_vars]))

```



#replace the missing values with median

```{r}
for(var in continous_vars){
  data[[var]][is.na(data[[var]])]<-
    median(data[[var]], na.rm=TRUE)
}
colSums(is.na(data[continous_vars]))
```


#find the mode of categorical function

```{r}
get_mode<-function(x){
  ux<-unique(na.omit(x))
  ux[which.max(tabulate(
    match(x, ux)
  ))]
}
cat(" the most category:", get_mode(data$Gender), "\n")
```



#replace the missing  categorical values with mode

```{r}
for(var in categorical_vars){
  mode_value<-get_mode(data[[var]])
    data[[var]][is.na(data[[var]])]<-mode_value
}
colSums(is.na(data[categorical_vars]))
```

#identification of outliers using IQR

```{r}
  find_outliers<- function(x){
    Q1<-quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE)
    Q3<-quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE)
    IQR_value<-Q3-Q1
    lower<-Q1-1.5*IQR_value
    upper<-Q3+1.5*IQR_value
    which(x<lower|x>upper)
  }

```



#find outliuers

```{r}
find_outliers(data$Income_KES)
find_outliers(data$Farm_Size_Acres)
```


#continous outliers in every continous varaiables using function supply

```{r}
outlier_count<-sapply(
  data[continous_vars],
  function(x) length(find_outliers)
)
outlier_count
```


#replacing outliers with median

```{r}
replace_outliers_median <- function(x) {
  
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  IQR_value <- Q3 - Q1
  
  lower <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
  upper <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value
  
  
  median_value <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  x[x < lower | x > upper] <- median_value
  
  return(x)
}

for (var in continous_vars) {
  
  data[[var]] <- replace_outliers_median(data[[var]])
}

```



#plot the boxplot for confiramation

```{r}
boxplot(
  data[continous_vars], 
  main="confirmation after outlier treatment",
  las=2,
  col="orange"
)
```
